sales_hooks: Constellation powers Microsoft Azure's AI training clusters with nuclear energy — the nuclear-to-AI pipeline is now a real supply chain layer. HBM suppliers should understand how power sourcing affects data center location decisions.
AI data centers need 24/7 reliable power, not intermittent solar/wind — nuclear is the only carbon-free source that matches AI compute's always-on profile. Constellation has a structural moat.
Every new GPU cluster requires a power contract before construction begins — Constellation's PPA pipeline is a 24-36 month forward indicator of where AI compute (and HBM) will be deployed.

Nuclear capacity shortage means power is constraining AI buildout ahead of GPU/HBM availability — memory suppliers should track power availability in key data center markets (Virginia, Illinois, Texas).
